resources.string: Choose where to open your desktop.
The desktop bundled in this app, as a guest. Sign-in, sync, mail and Agents are not available. Your data stays on this phone and is never uploaded.

Opens your MvL OS server in a secure browser tab. It is browser-hosted: sign in there with GitHub or Google, as on the web. Native app features are not available there. Data on this device is separate and is not uploaded or merged.
The app forgets this server address. This does NOT sign you out of the site in your browser. To sign out, use Sign out on the site, or clear that browser\'s data.
Open my choice automatically when the app starts
To come back here, close the browser tab, press Back on the desktop, or long-press the app icon and pick \"Choose mode\".
Install or enable a web browser to open a cloud server.
Enter your server\'s address, for example https://example.com.
Only https:// addresses are supported. http:// is not upgraded automatically: enter the https:// address.
The address contains spaces or characters that are not allowed.
Remove the user name or password from the address. Sign in on the site instead.
That is not a valid server name.
The port number is not valid.
